description: This is a test class for the PageStatistics component in a book tracking application. It contains unit tests for methods that compute statistics related to books, such as finding the book with the most pages and calculating the average page length.

classes.name: PageStatisticsTest
classes.description: Test class for PageStatistics, verifying methods like finding the book with the most pages and calculating average page length.

methods.name: PageStatisticsTest
methods.description: Constructor injecting BookService and PredefinedShelfService dependencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, clearing books and populating read books.

methods.name: findBookWithMostPages
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly identifies the book with the most pages.

methods.name: countOnlyReadBooksTowardsMostPagesStatistics
methods.description: Ensures only read books are considered when determining the book with the most pages.

methods.name: notDivideAveragePageLengthByZero
methods.description: Checks that the average page length calculation handles division by zero gracefully.

methods.name: calculateAveragePageLengthCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies correct calculation of average page length.

methods.name: calculateAveragePageLengthWithFloatPointCalculationCorrectly
methods.description: Tests the average page length calculation with floating point precision.

methods.name: resetPageStatistics
methods.description: Resets the test environment by deleting all books and reinitializing PageStatistics.
